card.name: Quantifiers inside 'one of the many' phrases
card.fires_on: Words that sit between a quantity or ranking phrase and the plural noun it describes, such as 'many', 'most', 'few', 'more' and 'first' in 'one of the first of ... many examples'. It is seen in descriptive web text about buildings, places and science.

modes.label: Possessive before many
modes.description: An apostrophe or 'many' after a place name, leading into a plural list of examples.
modes.example: one of the first of Buenos Aires<<'>> many examples of Second Empire architecture

modes.label: Quantity or ranking word
modes.description: A word like 'important', 'most', 'few' or 'first' that sits inside a 'one of the' or 'many of the' phrase.
modes.example: has been surrounded by many of the most<< important>> political institutions of the city

modes.label: Comparison or count words
modes.description: Words like 'more' or 'than' that follow a number or comparison and set up the next noun.
modes.example: Residential zoning usually includes a smaller FAR (floor area ratio)<< than>> business, commercial or industrial/manufacturing

card.plain: It fires on small words that count or rank things, such as 'many', 'most' or 'one of the first', just before the list of things they describe.
